content: Multi-step wizard architecture consensus across multiple 2025-2026 sources: model the wizard as a pure state machine whose state is DERIVED from answers, not stored. Persist answers plus current step id as a hint only; recompute step completion by replaying validators on load so resumes land on the first genuinely incomplete step. Use step IDs not indices in drafts. Editing an earlier answer marks dependent later steps stale (keep values, revoke complete). Keep network/submission out of the reducer. Put current step in the URL but treat it as untrusted input guarded by reachability. Debounce saves ~500ms, flush on visibilitychange, wrap storage in try/catch for private mode/quota errors, clear draft on successful submit, expire drafts ~7 days. Route-change wizards fail when steps hold local useState; state must live at module scope (Zustand) or a persistent parent/layout.
